Script 1 · "The pressure trap"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Pressure built a lot of careers. It rarely builds the next chapter."

Body

"Most of the high-achieving men I work with aren't short on drive. They've got plenty. What runs low is presence: at work, at home, in their own body. Running on pressure works for a while. Then it starts to cost more than it gives."

CTA

"I'm teaching a free 60-minute class on leading from presence instead. The replay is included. Tap Sign up to save your seat."

Shot: talking to camera, plain dark backdrop, same look as your profile photo.

Script 2 · "Five pillars"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"After 20 years of coaching men, I keep coming back to five things."

Body

"Movement. Breath. Language. Meditation. Nature. None of them need more hours in your day. They change the starting point, so the hours you already have feel different."

CTA

"I'll walk you through all five in a free live masterclass called Lead From Presence. Tap Sign up."

Shot: outdoors, walking toward camera, each pillar appears as on-screen text.

Script 3 · "The drive home"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"What happens in the ten minutes after you get home from work?"

Body

"For a lot of men, that's when the day's pressure walks through the door with them. A simple practice in those ten minutes can change how the whole evening goes. I'll show you the one I teach."

CTA

"It's part of my free live class, Lead From Presence. Seats are free. Tap Sign up below."
